releaseNotes: HWM 0.2.5.5 hardens the isolated HWM Terminal fast channel in service 0.2.5.4. Terminal queue polling now uses authenticated POST requests rather than GET and logs the Azure rejection body if a poll is refused. This aligns the command transport with the proven heartbeat request pattern while keeping monitoring, remediation and Mesh recovery unchanged. Terminal safety limits remain: one-shot PowerShell or CMD, short expiry, maximum 60 second runtime, bounded output, operator audit identity and process-tree termination on timeout. Tray 1.0.0.6 and Managed Updater 0.1.3.0 are unchanged.
